tool.name: Azure API Management AI gateway
tool.description: AI gateway policies in Azure API Management for LLM, MCP and A2A APIs: token limits, semantic caching, content safety and load balancing.
strengths: Foundry integration for models, agents, tools
tool.statusNote: The AI gateway is part of API Management, not a separate offering, and availability varies by service tier. The unified model API and the AI gateway in Microsoft Foundry integration are in preview (as of 2026-09-30).
tool.practitionerNote: The natural choice for Azure OpenAI / Foundry estates that already run APIM, especially to spread PTU and pay-as-you-go capacity across many apps. Check that the policies you need are available in your APIM tier, and note that semantic caching needs Azure Managed Redis or another RediSearch-compatible cache.
tool.logoNotes: Fallback: no reviewed logo asset sourced yet.

dataResidency.detail: Instances deploy to chosen Azure regions; the self-hosted gateway (Developer/Premium) keeps traffic in customer environments, but it still sends config, heartbeat and optional telemetry traffic to Azure.

deployment.detail: Managed Azure service; the containerized self-hosted gateway enables hybrid and multicloud data planes.

auditLogging.detail: Logs prompts, completions and token usage to Azure Monitor / Application Insights, with a built-in token dashboard.

soc2.detail: Azure is covered by the Azure SOC 2 Type 2 attestation; per-service scope is in the audit report.

iso27001.detail: Azure is covered by the Azure ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certificate; per-service scope is in the certificate.

iso42001.detail: ISO 42001 scope for API Management not confirmed in the sources reviewed.

euAiAct.detail: API gateway infrastructure, not an AI system placed on the market; obligations rest with the deployer and model providers.

licenseRisk.detail: Proprietary Azure service; policies are APIM-specific, so there is Azure lock-in.
